dedupe_keys.name: consumi di energia elettrica suddivisi per tipo di utilizzo

description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes electricity consumption divided by type of use for 2006 to 2011, citing ENEL as the source. One CSV distribution is described in the municipal catalogue. The data provide a historical electricity-demand breakdown that can inform capacity-planning inputs for the municipality. The native description does not enumerate the use categories or state the consumption unit, sampling interval or missing-value conventions. It therefore does not establish an hourly load curve or a complete consumer-level panel. Public access is free under Creative Commons Attribution, although the licence version is not identified. The source records a legacy shortened distribution address; the catalogue metadata remains the verified entry point. Related municipal electricity records cover public buildings and public lighting, but the overlap between those sector extracts and this table has not been quantified. They should not be added together without checking their accounting boundaries.
